# Capability parity: dsh web client vs Whalee

<!-- Generated by tool/capability_parity.py from docs/capability-parity.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

One row per upstream item of the pinned dsh (`687f282e8`, npm `0.2.1-rc.2`): every `packages/client/ui-*` package, every `@Remote`
method, every slot name and every settings namespace, each marked **ported**, **partial**, **missing** or **na** (not
applicable, with the reason) and with the **platform** it is meant for (`phone`, `desktop` or `both`).
The source of truth is [`capability-parity.json`](capability-parity.json); the status of a
row comes from reading the Whalee code at the path in its `whalee` field. `tool/capability_parity.py --check` (part of
`tool/preflight`) is red when the pin has an item without a row.

## Packages still to do, by priority

**P1**

- `ui-commands` (partial, both): Type "/" to see and run the host's slash commands (for example /compact, /goal, /plan) from the message box. Directory cache, the `/` source with the decision tables, popupSelect and action kinds, contributions (File, Model) and the Permission decoration are ported. Missing: sticky group headings in the popup; `/feedback` has no dialog and `/export` no download (their client halves ui-message-feedback and ui-settings-session-log are not ported), so both are listed and run as plain Host commands.
- `ui-input-trigger` (partial, both): Type "/" or "@" in the message box to open a candidate menu and insert the pick. The slash/@ pipeline and programmatic plus launcher are implemented. Plus restores composer focus and opens the leading or inline command source without inserting text; selection-aware command picks retain remaining draft text. Actual reducer vectors and keyboard/application flows pass. Skill decorations and chip persistence remain in the subsequent Skill/settings scope.
- `ui-layout` (partial, desktop): Resize and collapse the three-column window: sidebar, conversation and right column. dsh AppFrame: three-column solve, drag handles, collapse below 1024 with the narrow override, ctx.layout, main panel selection, the shell seats, per-platform window chrome (macOS and Windows compile-safe, untested). Below 600 wide the sidebar is a modal drawer under a phone top bar (owner decision 2026-10-24); 600 to 1023 the rail, 1024 and up docked.
- `ui-sidebar` (partial, both): Browse sessions in a tree grouped by workspace, search them, and see which are running. Brand row (Whalee mark and name), New Session, Plugins and Automation tasks entries, the browsing region and the foot, the 56px rail, and the macOS and Windows variants. Plugins and Automation tasks open a "not available yet" page.
- `ui-workspace` (partial, both): Pick a workspace (project folder) and keep sessions grouped, pinned, archived and ordered under it. Workspace tree/search/create, session pin/rename/fork/archive/restore and workspace rename/delete/order; local session drag order, hover cards, marquee, row extension seats and subagent ancestry. Remaining: shared access-snapshot gating, command shortcut hints and keyed workspace.toast factory (current notices are direct overlays).

**P2**

- `ui-chat` (partial, both): Read the conversation: your messages, streamed answers with collapsible reasoning, tool calls, turn errors, and the copy action. Renders all 19 chat node kinds dsh declares (user, steering, turn-trigger, assistant-step, tool-call, turn-tail, turn-error, turn-max-tokens, model-retry, system-prompt, command, command-input, context, question-reply, compaction, manual-compaction, turn-process, workflow-run, unknown). Stream behaviour matches dsh web: "Loading history…" hint while a session opens, the "Load earlier" control (read automatically as well when the reader nears the top, which dsh does not), the plain back-to-bottom chevron, follow of the latest end, copy and clock under messages (hover-revealed where a pointer can hover), tappable http(s) and file links, one selection across messages. Kept from raft-flutter without a visible change: a two-sided timeline (older pages never move the reader), per-session reading position (memory only), scrollbar thumb drag on wide windows. Raft's skeleton and the "N new" count are behind one flag (`streamExtras`, off). Not ported: the turn rail (TurnNavigator), fork-at-message (needs session/fork), like/dislike (ui-message-feedback), unresolved arbitrary URLs written as inline code, the link glyph, selection that survives rows leaving the built range (the list is lazy). System-prompt cards now interpret system messages, positional replacements and request-series anchors, with bounded plain-text disclosures; they remain outside the normal transcript per upstream visibility in every display mode; raw request inspection belongs to Trajectory. Model retry chains are correlated by producer retryId; scheduled, started and boundary-cancelled states, a client-clock countdown and expandable failure details are implemented. Automatic compaction markers require a landed checkpoint and use only its loaded summary evidence; shadowed transcript remains visible. Manual compaction is folded into its command identity, including partial-window fallbacks. Ordinary commands use a command-name keyed seat and retain complete plain-text settlements; multiline output expands. Compaction summaries expand as Markdown with a header pinned within their row. Turn process controls fold only eligible completed ranges and preserve the final reply, partial-window boundaries and interleaved input. Four work-detail modes and independent completion/next-input timing are Host-backed; process groups split reasoning and response references without duplicating node data. Coordinated collapse animation, nested-group pagination compensation and some text/Markdown fidelity remain follow-up work. Goal command inputs are projected separately from command results; answered late question replies exclusively own their source messages and copy the full answer. Context disclosures support instructions, catalog, snapshot, notice, relay and recall with all-or-nothing opaque fallbacks and bounded bodies. Ordinary contexts remain hidden, while tool additions/removals retain upstream visibility. Workflow runs keep durable run/member outcomes and collision-free phase identities, distinguish normal foreground closure from abandoned turns, and defer clean collapse while member focus remains inside. Sent text now delegates to the extensible user-text factory for references and masks. Closing inline-code file mentions resolve only successful mutations and declared deliveries in the same closed turn; ambiguous and unknown tokens remain plain.
- `ui-conversation` (partial, both): The session screen: header with title and actions, message box with send and stop, to-do dock, and the takeover seat for approvals and questions. The composer is dsh's one rounded card (draft on top, attach, permission, model and send in the row inside it) and a blank session shows the centered hero with its workspace chip and the inert no-workspace card. Queue rows support count disclosure, text-only inline edit, remove and steer with durable occurrence ids, disabled pending rows and image/file previews. Busy-Enter preferences are Host-backed; Enter/Send share delivery intent, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter uses its opposite, and empty accelerated Enter steers queued occurrences in order. Missing: the hero's agent preset and options, the DeepSeek brand mark (na), composer toolbar seats (activity, left, right), in-composer plan control.
- `ui-deliverables` (partial, both): Review everything the agent changed in one place: a changed-files card with per-file diffs, delivery cards and clickable file references in the final answer. Implemented turn-local successful mutation evidence, declared deliveries, Host-served change summaries and diffs, four-card folds, a stable Review sidebar resource with per-navigation file selection and split/wrap choices, shared cancellable reads/native gesture feedback, and closing-code file mentions resolved only against recorded evidence. Render/transport/application routing tests and actual upstream contract vectors pass. Native capture and visual alignment are being evaluated; optional tool inspector integration belongs to the diagnostic views work.
- `ui-dockkit` (partial, desktop): Arrange panels in a draggable split-tree docking layout. The split-tree engine with invertible operations (ported with its vectors) and the docking surface of the right sidebar (tabs, splits, drag between panes, 4-pane cap). The drop-zone preview animation of the web client is simplified.
- `ui-goal` (partial, both): See, edit, pause, resume, complete and clear the session goal in a bar above the message box. Projected versioned goal dock with live activation fencing, edit/pause/resume/clear; actual source behavior and native evaluation tracked in task15.
- `ui-reference` (partial, both): Mention a workspace file or another session with "@" so the agent reads it. Composer file/folder/session/direct-subagent source, serialization and preview are implemented. Sent file/folder labels render through keyed user-text seats; files preserve the originating Session authority with local retry/close feedback. Session labels use only the immediately sourced recall record. Remaining visual detail: long sent chips are atomic WidgetSpans instead of upstream plain inline wrapping; tracked by visual task6.

**P3**

- `ui-agent-preset` (partial, both): Choose the agent preset (which plugin set an agent runs with) for later sessions and for this session, and edit the preset composition. Settings/default selection, YAML composition, guides, one-shot blank-session choice and Creator landing; native/visual evaluation pending.
- `ui-jobs` (partial, both): List the session's background jobs and watch or kill one from its streaming output panel. Refcounted roster/follow streams, byte-cursor output tails, bounded rendering, two-press stop and local settled fold/clear; native/visual evaluation pending.
- `ui-open-in-app` (partial, desktop): Open the workspace folder or a previewed file in an application installed on the host. The Session header split button and the workspace.openLocal command over the host routes; offered only where the host is this machine. The document and file actions are not ported.
- `ui-plugin-manager` (partial, both): Install, enable, disable, retry and remove plugin packages on the host. Host-derived bundle/row controls, request-owned installation/cancellation/recovery, explicit script approval and registry selection. Exact component styling and arbitrary browser-plugin UI modules remain separate work.
- `ui-schedule` (partial, both): List, edit and delete the host's scheduled tasks and a session's reminders. Cross-Session manager/search/status, exact-rule editing, cron builder, original Session history/deletion, header and sidebar seats, replay cards. Durable sidebar-layout restore and precise visual alignment remain; time zone picker uses IANA names rather than ICU city labels.
- `ui-settings-agent-loop` (partial, both): Set how many tool calls the agent may run in parallel. Served staged maxParallelToolCalls, revision-fenced save/reset; native/visual validation pending.
- `ui-settings-models` (partial, both): Add and edit model providers and their API keys, discover models, and pick the default. Provider directory, write-only credentials, discovery, custom routes, catalog models and versioned welcome are implemented. Composer selection already calls session/selectModel, which saves the Host default in the background. Native/visual validation continues; native account credential onboarding is separate.
- `ui-settings-shell` (partial, both): Set the shell command timeout and the per-stream output cap. Both bash-sandbox and pwsh-sandbox are selected from served namespaces; staged timeoutMs and maxOutputBytes save/reset. Native/visual validation pending.
- `ui-settings-subagent` (partial, both): Set subagent recursion depth, parallel capacity and which models agents may choose for subagents. Staged safe-integer depth/capacity and exact provider/model allowlist; unavailable routes retained, revision conflicts and reconnect resets checked. Native/visual validation pending.
- `ui-settings-web-search` (partial, both): Set the DeepSeek web-search API key, endpoint and per-request search budget. Three staged namespaces, API switch, endpoint/limits, write-only key and credential facts, ordered section-before-selection save. Actual upstream controller traces match; native/visual validation pending.
- `ui-sidebar-documentpreview` (partial, both): Preview files in the sidebar: code, Markdown, images, and also Office documents, spreadsheets, PDF and HTML. Code/Markdown/image/text plus PDFium, opaque static/interactive HTML with authorized finite assets, and Session-authorized Office PDF conversion. Dedicated spreadsheet viewer, exact PDF controls and native modal-background capture parity remain incomplete.
- `ui-skill` (partial, both): See a skill the agent used as its own row and reference skills in your messages. Session-keyed catalog and literal /skill picks, invalidation, original-Session previews, sent references and durable tool rows. Editable draft spans preserve literal text; visual chip details remain in task6.
- `ui-subagent` (partial, both): See the subagents a session started, read each child's transcript, continue a child and mention one with "@". Header catalog with status and read-only child transcripts. Missing: sending a message to a child (subagents/prompt), interrupt from the parent, "@" reference source, sidebar chat tab.
- `ui-workflow-run` (partial, both): Follow a durable workflow run in the conversation, with its member agents expandable. Durable workflow lifecycle projection, exact phase grouping, status counts and run/member disclosure are implemented. Clean completion collapses after keyboard focus leaves; abnormal/new cycles reopen. Current direct-child/session identity facts gate navigation. Visual alignment is still being verified and remains partial.

**P4**

- `ui-message-feedback` (missing, both): Like or dislike an answer and send a written remark about a message or the session. messageFeedback/* and sessionFeedback/record are not generated or called.
- `ui-plugin-market` (partial, both): Browse the configured plugin market indexes and install a bundle from the Discover tab. Configured indexes, pinned-document paging, search/declared filters, version/source confirmation and exact Host installation targets. Detail artwork, sort toolbar and strict visual alignment remain incomplete.
- `ui-settings-account` (missing, both): Sign in to a DeepSeek account, see balance and bonuses, and open Platform billing. Not yet generated or rendered. Pinned account/controller supports safe state/profile/balance and browser authorization; client metadata is build version, locale and timezone. Native sign-in needs an actual browser-accessible loopback callback origin. No unofficial-client approval hold is inferred; native account integration belongs with platform authentication work.
- `ui-settings-general` (partial, both): The General settings section: language, appearance, permissions default, host details and version. Has language, appearance and font size, permission default, notifications (device), host and certificate, host version. Missing: developer-tools switch, the versioned welcome notice and onboarding.
- `ui-settings-plugin-inventory` (partial, both): Read the host's loaded plugin inventory in a read-only tab. Read-only global/preset inventory, search, conditional enablement and runtime states. Browser module graph synchronization has no equivalent in the native client.
- `ui-settings-session-log` (partial, both): Choose whether session logs are uploaded with DeepSeek API requests. Accepted Host upload toggle and persistent keyed shell notice; native/visual validation pending.
- `ui-sidebar-browser` (missing, both): Open a sandboxed web page in a right-sidebar tab. No browser tab kind.
- `ui-trajectory` (missing, both): Read the full event ledger of a session with a timing overview (a developer view). No trajectory conversation view.
